svg.text: ORB orientation module: input patch vs expected vs Verilog
37x37 window -> intensity-centroid angle, N_SECT=64, rounding=paper. Angles in the image frame: 0 deg = right, 90 deg = down.
Solid arrow = quantised sector, dashed line = exact atan2 of the moments, grey ticks = sector centres, red box = window centre pixel.
Result: 8/8 patches identical (m00, m10, m01, quadrant, sector).
